# 1 Samuel Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 159r–159v | **Source Image:** 1SA_016_page_001.jpg, 1SA_016_page_002.jpg

---

**16:1** And-said YHWH to-Samuel, "Until when will-you mourn for-Saul, and-I have-rejected him from-reigning over-Israel? Fill your-horn [with]-oil and-go. I-will-send-you to-Jesse the-Bethlehemite, for I-have-seen [ra'iti] among-his-sons for-Me a-king."

**16:2** And-said Samuel, "How shall-I-go? And-Saul will-hear and-kill-me." And-said YHWH, "A-heifer of-the-herd take in-your-hand, and-you-shall-say, 'To-sacrifice to-YHWH I-have-come.'

**16:3** And-you-shall-call Jesse to-the-sacrifice, and-I will-make-known to-you what you-shall-do, and-you-shall-anoint for-Me [him]-whom I-say to-you."

**16:4** And-did Samuel [that]-which YHWH spoke, and-he-came to-Beth-lehem. And-trembled the-elders of-the-city to-meet-him, and-he-said, "Peace [shalom] [is]-my-coming.

**16:5** To-sacrifice to-YHWH I-have-come. Consecrate-yourselves and-come with-me to-the-sacrifice." And-he-consecrated Jesse and-his-sons and-called-them to-the-sacrifice.

**16:6** And-it-was when-they-came, and-he-saw Eliab, and-he-said, "Surely before YHWH [is]-His-anointed."

**16:7** And-said YHWH to-Samuel, "Do-not look to-his-appearance and-to-[the]-height of-his-stature, for I-have-rejected-him. For not as-the-man sees [does God see]; for the-man sees to-the-eyes, but-YHWH sees to-the-heart."

**16:8** And-called Jesse to-Abinadab and-passed-him before Samuel. And-he-said, "Also this-one YHWH has-not chosen."

**16:9** And-passed Jesse Shammah. And-he-said, "Also this-one YHWH has-not chosen."

**16:10** And-passed Jesse seven of-his-sons before Samuel. And-said Samuel to-Jesse, "YHWH has-not chosen these."

**16:11** And-said Samuel to-Jesse, "Are-the-young-men complete [ha-tammu]?" And-he-said, "There-remains yet the-youngest, and-behold, he-is-shepherding the-flock." And-said Samuel to-Jesse, "Send and-take-him, for we-will-not sit-around [nasov] until he-comes here."

**16:12** And-he-sent and-brought-him. And-he [was]-ruddy [admoni], with beauty of-eyes and-good of-appearance. And-said YHWH, "Arise, anoint-him, for this [is]-he."

**16:13** And-took Samuel the-horn of-the-oil and-anointed him in-[the]-midst of-his-brothers. And-rushed [the]-spirit of-YHWH upon David from-that day and-onward. And-arose Samuel and-went to-Ramah.

**16:14** And-[the]-spirit of-YHWH departed from-upon Saul, and-terrified-him an-evil spirit from-YHWH.

**16:15** And-said [the]-servants of-Saul to-him, "Behold, please, an-evil spirit of-God [is]-terrifying-you.

**16:16** Let-say, please, our-lord, [to]-your-servants before-you — let-them-seek a-man [who is a]-knower of-playing on-the-lyre. And-it-will-be when-there-is upon-you an-evil spirit of-God, and-he-will-play with-his-hand, and-it-will-be-good for-you."

**16:17** And-said Saul to-his-servants, "See for-me, please, a-man who-plays-well and-bring [him] to-me."

**16:18** And-answered one of-the-young-men and-said, "Behold, I-have-seen a-son of-Jesse the-Bethlehemite, [who is a]-knower of-playing, and-a-mighty-man of-valor [gibbor chayil] and-a-man of-war, and-discerning of-word [nevon davar], and-a-man of-form [ish to'ar], and-YHWH [is]-with-him."

**16:19** And-sent Saul messengers to-Jesse and-said, "Send to-me David your-son who [is]-with the-flock."

**16:20** And-took Jesse a-donkey [of]-bread and-a-skin of-wine and-one kid of-goats, and-sent [them] by-[the]-hand of-David his-son to-Saul.

**16:21** And-came David to-Saul and-stood before-him. And-he-loved him exceedingly, and-he-became for-him [an]-armor-bearer.

**16:22** And-sent Saul to-Jesse, saying, "Let-stand, please, David before-me, for he-has-found favor in-my-eyes."

**16:23** And-it-was when-[the]-spirit of-God [was]-upon Saul, and-took David the-lyre and-played with-his-hand, and-there-was-relief [ravach] for-Saul, and-it-was-good for-him, and-the-evil spirit departed from-upon-him.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **16:1 — "horn" vs. "flask"**: Samuel is told to fill his *qeren* (horn) — not the *pak* (flask) used for Saul's anointing (10:1). The horn is the instrument of permanent, dynastic anointing.

2. **16:7 — "YHWH sees to the heart"**: The programmatic statement of the chapter. The verb *ra'ah* (to see) is used 7 times in ch.16, creating a motif of true vs. false seeing.

3. **16:12 — admoni** (אַדְמוֹנִי): "Ruddy" — the same word describes Esau (Gen 25:25). David's redness may link to his name (*David/Dod*) and to blood/vitality themes.

4. **16:14 — "evil spirit from YHWH"**: The Hebrew is unambiguous: *ruach ra'ah me-et YHWH*. The spirit comes from YHWH. EMET does not soften this.

5. **16:18 — Five-fold description of David**: The servant's description lists five qualities, making this one of the most elaborate character introductions in Samuel.

— EMET
